name: Mahendra Singh Mahara
summary:

diversified industries. Seeking to contribute to audit engagements through solid technical skills, analytical review, and compliance with Companies

responsibilities: Leading CA firm in Gurugram with 100+ clientele and 15+ employees.

Performed statutory audits in accordance with the Companies Act, 2013, ensuring integrity of general ledger balances, accuracy of transaction recording, and compliance with applicable accounting standards across manufacturing, trading, and service sectors.

Improved financial reporting reliability through detailed examination of accounts payable and receivable, validation of capitalization and CWIP, and assessment of inventory controls and valuation practices.

Oversaw physical verification activities for key clients including Asian Paints, Care India Foundation, Foodstories, and Development Alternatives, resulting in enhanced data accuracy, stronger internal controls, and a 20% improvement in audit efficiency.

Concluded statutory audit reports for over 30 clients by compiling audit observations, validating disclosures, and ensuring compliance with the Companies Act, CARO requirements, Standards on Auditing, and relevant regulatory frameworks.

Assessed internal control environments by executing IFC walkthroughs, evaluating control design and operating effectiveness using Risk Control Matrices, identifying gaps, and recommending corrective actions.

Executed GST and tax audit assignments across trading, retail, manufacturing, and service sectors, encompassing tax audit report finalization, ITC verification, GSTR reconciliation analysis, and statutory adherence.
Administered the complete filing lifecycle of 100+ Income Tax Returns (ITRs) for individuals, HNIs, and corporate entities, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and full regulatory compliance.
Drafted detailed submissions in response to various income tax assessment and scrutiny notices, strengthening client representations and assessment outcomes.
Addressed complex GST notices, including high-value matters, and supported documentation and filings for Advance Ruling applications.
Compiled complete sets of financial statements for more than 50 clients in accordance with GAAP, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and timely reporting.
